description: Set whether a blog publication is served by PostKing ('postking', the default) or by the customer's OWN app ('self_hosted'). Self-hosted means the customer renders the blog themselves against the public blog API (GET /api/blog-posts?blogId=<publicationId>). A minimal, MIT-licensed example is https://github.com/bitsandtea/postking-selfhost (env POSTKING_API_URL, POSTKING_BLOG_ID, SITE_URL) — optional, not required; any custom build against that endpoint works the same. For a production host, add a Domain with hostingMode: 'self_hosted' (add_domain), verify it (verify_domain — TXT ownership only), then connect_domain_to_publication. Mode-match rule: the publication's connected domain must have the same hostingMode as the publication. A mismatch returns 409 hosting_mode_mismatch — disconnect the domain or add one with the matching hostingMode.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

hostingMode.description: 'postking' (default, PostKing serves it), 'self_hosted' (you render it against the public API) or 'external' (your own site serves it; PostKing only emits URLs, no domain may be connected).

publicationId.description: Blog publication ID (from list_publications or list_blogs)

name: set_publication_hosting_mode
